English: The novel coronavirus (COVID-19) caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), emerged in the city of Wuhan, China in December 2019.
Luganda: Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka corona akapya (COVID-19), obuleetebwa akawuka ka corona ak’amaanyi akakwata omussizo (SARS-Cov-2), bwatandikira mu kibuga ky’e Wuhan, mu China mu Deesemba wa 2019.
Yoruba: Àjàkálẹ̀ àrun Kòrónà tuntun (COVID-19) tí àìsàn àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn kòrónà ajẹ́mọ-èémí 2 (SARS-CoV-2), jẹ jáde láti ìlú Wuhan, China ní oṣù Ọpẹ́ 2019.
Zulu: ‬‬Isifo esisha segciwane le corona (COVID-19), esidalwa igciwane elicindezela ukuphefumula 2 (SARS-CoV-2) saqubuka edolobheni lase Wuhan, eShayina ngoDisemba ka-2019.
Hausa: Sabuwar annobar coronavirus (COVID-19) da mummunar cutar numfashi ta coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) ta haifar, ta ɓulla a birnin Wuhan na ƙasar Sin a watan Disamba na shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Coronavirus (COVID-19) ye e bakilwego ke bolwetši bjo bo kekilego kudu bja go hema bja 2 (SARS-CoV-2), bo thomile go tšwelela ka toropokgolong ya Wuhan, ka China ka Desemere 2019.
Amharic: አዲሱ ኮሮና ቫይረስ፣ ወይም ኮቪድ-19 የተሰኘው በሽታ፣ ሳርስ- ኮቭ -2 (ከባድ እና አጣዳፊ የመተንፈሻ አካላት በሽታ) በተሰኘ ቫይረስ የሚከሰት ሲሆን፣ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የታየው ቻይና ውስጥ በምትገኝ፣ ውሃን በተሰኘች ከተማ በታህሳስ 2012 ዓ.ም

English: Although, the disease appears on the African continent late, it has spread to virtually all the countries.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’obulwadde buno bwajja luvannyuma ku ssemazinga Afrika, busaasaanidde kyenkana amawanga gonna.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ó pé kí àrùn náà farahàn ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì Áfíríkà, ó ti hàn káàkiri gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè tó wà níbẹ̀.
Zulu: Yize lesi sifo sifike kade ezwenikazi lase-Afrika, sesibhebhethekele cishe kuwo wonke amazwe.
Hausa: Ko da yake, cutar ta bayyana a nahiyar Afirka a makare, amma duk da haka ta yaɗu zuwa kusan dukkan ƙasashen.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, bolwetši bjo bo phulegile ka Afrika moragonyana, gomme bo phatlaletše ka dinageng ka moka.
Amharic: ላይ ነው፡፡ ከሌሎች ሃገሮች አንጻር፣ ወደ አፍሪካ የገባው ዘግይቶ ቢሆንም፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ወደ ሁሉም የአህጉሩ ሃገራት ለመዛመት ችሏል፡፡

English: We provide early spatio-temporal dynamics of COVID-19 within the first 62 days of the disease’s appearance on the African continent.
Luganda: Tulaga ensaasaana ya COVID-19 mu nnaku 62 ezaasooka ng’obulwadde buno bwakalabika ku ssemazinga Afrika.
Yoruba: A pèse ọwọ́jà ati àkókò-ìtànkálẹ̀ ti COVID-19 láàárín ọjọ́ 62 àkọ́kọ́ tí àrùn náà fojú hàn ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Sihlinzeka izimonguquko ngokwendawo nesikhathi ze-COVID-19 esikhathini esizinsuku ezingama-62 zokuqala kokuvela kwalesi sifo ezwenikazi lase-Afrika.
Hausa: Mun samar da Sifashiyo-temforal dainamis na COVID-19 na farko a cikin kwanaki 62 na farkon bayyanar cutar a nahiyar Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Re fana ka diphetogo tša lebakanyana mafelong tša ka pela mabapi le COVID-19 mo matšatšing a 62 ka morago ga ge bolwetši bjo bo phulegile ka khonthinenteng ya Afrika.
Amharic: በሽታው አፍሪካ ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከታየበት ቀን ጀምሮ ባሉት 62 ቀናት በጊዜ እና በቦታ መለዋወጥ የሚፈጠሩ የኮቪድ-19 ክስተቶችን የቅድሚያ መረጃ እናቀርባለን፡፡

English: We used a two-parameter hurdle Poisson model to simultaneously analyze the zero counts and the frequency of occurrence.
Luganda: Tukozesa enkola ya Poisson ey’okubala emirundi ebiri okwekenneenya mu kiseera kyekimu awo awatali muntu alwadde n’omuwendo gw’abafunye obulwadde.
Yoruba: A lo módẹ́ẹ̀lì gbèdéke onípele-méjì Poisson láti ṣàtiúpalẹ̀ ìka òdo àti ìlemọ́ ìgbà ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀.
Zulu: Sisebenzise indlelakusebenza ye two-parameterr hurdle Poisson ukuze sihlaziye kanyekanye lapho okungaveli lutho khona nokuvama kokwenzeka.
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da samfurin cikas na Poisson mai siga biyu don nazarin ƙidayar sifili da yawan abin da ya faru a lokaci guda.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše mokgwatirišo wa magato a mabedi wa Poisson go sekaseka ka nako e tee dipalo tša lefeela le go hlaga kgafetšakgafetša ya bolwetši.
Amharic: ዜሮ የተመዘገበባቸውን ውጤቶች እና የክስተቱን ድግግሞሽ በአንድ ላይ ለመተንተን፣ ፖይስን የተባለ በሁለት ዙር ሞዴል የተጠና የስታትስቲክስ መረጃን ተጠቅመናል፡፡

English: We investigate the effects of important healthcare capacities including hospital beds and number of medical doctors in the different countries.
Luganda: Tunoonyereza ku bukulu bw’ebikozesebwa mu bujjanjabi omuli ebitanda by’omu malwaliro n’omuwendo gw’abasawo mu mawanga ag’enjawulo.
Yoruba: A ṣe ìwádìí ipa lórí pàtàki àwọn ohun èlo ètò ìlera tí ibùsun ilé ìwòsán àti iye àwọn dókítà wà lára rẹ̀ ní oríṣiríṣi orílẹ̀-èdè.
Zulu: Siphenya imithelela yamakhono ezinsizakusebenza zezempilo okubalwa kuzo imibhede yasezibhedlela nenani lodokotela emazweni ahlukene.
Hausa: Muna binciken sakamakon muhimman kayayyakin kiwon lafiya da suka haɗa da gadajen asibiti da adadin likitocin a ƙasashe daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Re sekaseka diabe tše bohlokwa tša bokgoni bja tlhokomelo ya maphelo go akaretšwa mepete ya sepetlele le dingaka tša maphelo tše mmalwa ka dinageng tše di fapafapanego.
Amharic: ጤናን የመጠበቅ አቅምን በዋነኝነት የሚወስኑት የሆስፒታል አልጋ እና የዶክተሮች ቁጥር የመሳሰሉት ግብአቶች በተለያዩ ሃገራት ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ እንመረምራለን፡፡

English: The results show that cases of the pandemic vary geographically across Africa with notable high incidence in neighboring countries particularly in West and North Africa.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu biraga nti omuwendo gw’abalina obuwadde gukyukakyuka okwetooloola Afrika ng’omuwendo omunene gusangibwa mu mawanga agaliraanaganye naddala mu Bugwanjuba n’Obukiikakkono bwa Afrika.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì ìwádìí fi hàn pé ipa àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn náà yàtọọ láti ibìkan sí òmíràn káàkiri ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tó hànde ní àwọn orílẹ̀-ède agbègbe Ìwọ̀-Oòrùn àti Àríwá Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi ukutholakala kwalolu bhubhane kuyahluka ngokwezindawo e-Afrika kubonakala izinombolo eziphezulu emazweni aseNtshonalanga naseNyakatho ne-Afrika.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa cutar ta ɓarke a faɗin Afirka inda ake samun yawaitar ɓarkewar cutar a ƙasashe maƙwabta musamman a Yammacin Afirka da Arewacin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laetša gore go phulega ga leuba le go a fapana go ya ka mafelo go ralala le Afrika fao go bonagalago go phulega ga bolwetši kudu ka dinagamabapi kudukudu ka Bodikela le Leboa la Afrika.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የወረርሽኙ ክስተት በአፍሪካ ዙሪያ በሚገኝ መልከዐ ምድራዊ አቀማመጥ ልዩነት የሚቀያየር ሲሆን፣ በአጎራባች ሃገሮች፣ በተለይም በምእራብ እና በሰሜን አፍሪካ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የበሽታ ክስተት ታይቷል፡፡

English: The burden of the disease (per 100,000) was most felt in Djibouti Tunisia, Morocco and Algeria.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abalwadde abakwatibwa omunene (ku buli bantu 100,000) gwali mu Djibouti, Tunisia, Morocco ne Algeria.
Yoruba: Ìdi àrùn náà (per 100,000) jẹ́ èyí tó nípa jùlọ ní Djibouti Tunisia, Morocco àti Algeria.
Zulu: Umthwalo walesi sifo (esibalweni sabantu abayi-100 000) uzwakale kakhulu eJibhuthi, eThunisiya, eMorikho nase-Aljeriya.
Hausa: An fi jin nauyin cutar (mutum ɗaya a cikin 100,000) a Djibouti Tunisiya da Moroko da kuma Aljeriya.
Northern Sotho: Bothata bja bolwetši bjo (ka balwetši ba 100,000) bo itemogetšwe kudu ka Djibouti Tunisia, Morocco le Algeria.
Amharic: የበሽታው ጫና (በየአንዳንዱ 100 ሺ ሰው) በጅቡቲ፣ በቱኒዚያ፣ በሞሮኮ እና በአልጄሪያ ከብዶ ታይቷል፡፡

English: Temporally, during the first 4 weeks, the burden was highest in Senegal, Egypt and Mauritania, but by mid-April it shifted to Somalia, Chad, Guinea, Tanzania, Gabon, Sudan, and Zimbabwe.
Luganda: Mu wiiki 4 ezaasooka, omuwendo gw’abakwatibwa gwali gusinga kuba munene mu Senegal, Egypt ne Mauritania, naye wakati w’Ogwokuna embeera eno yakyuka n’egenda mu Somalia, Chad, Guinea, Tanzania, Gabon, Sudan, ne Zimbabwe.
Yoruba: Fúgbà díẹ̀, fún ọ̀sẹ̀ 4 àkọ́kọ́, ìdì náà pọ̀ ní Senegal, Egypt àti Mauritania, ṣùgbọ́n láti àárín oṣù Igbe ó sún sí Somalia, Chad, Guinea, Tanzania, Gabon, Sudan, àti Zimbabwe.
Zulu: Ngokwesikhathi, emavikini ama-4 okuqala, umthwalo wawuphezulu kunazo zonke izindawo eSenegal, eGibhithe naseMorithaniya, kodwa phakathi noMbasa wagudlukela eSomaliya, e-Shed, eGini, eThanzaniya, eGabhoni, eSudani naseZimbabwe.
Hausa: Na ɗan lokaci, a cikin makonni 4 na farko, nauyin ya fi girma a Senegal da Masar da Mauritaniya, amma a tsakiyar watan Afrilu ya koma Somaliya da Chadi, Guinea da Tanzaniya da Gabon da Sudanda kuma Zimbabwe.
Northern Sotho: Mo nakong ya lebakanyana, mo dibekeng tša mathomo tše 4, bothata bja bolwetši bjo bo bile godimodimo ka Senegal, Egypt le ka Mauritania, eupša magareng ga Aprele bothata bjo bo ile bja fetela ka Somalia, Chad, Guinea, Tanzania, Gabon, Sudan, le Zimbabwe.
Amharic: ከጊዜያዊ ለውጥ አኳያ፣ በመጀመሪያዎቹ 4 ሳምንታት የበሽታው ጫና በሴኔጋል፣ በግብጽ እና በሞሪታኒያ በጣም ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡ ነገር ግን በሚያዚያ ወር አጋማሽ ላይ ወደ ሶማሊያ፣ ቻድ፣ ጊኒ፣ ታንዛኒያ፣ ጋቦን፣ ሱዳን እና ዚምቧብዌ ዞሮ ነበር፡፡

English: Currently, Namibia, Angola, South Sudan, Burundi and Uganda have the least burden.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kino, Namibia, Angola, South Sudan, Burundi ne Uganda ge gasinga okuba n’abantu abatono abafuna obulwadde.
Yoruba: Lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, Namibia, Angola, South Sudan, Burundi àti Uganda ní ìdì tó kéré jù.
Zulu: Njengamanje, iNamibhiya, i-Angola, iNingizimu Sudan, iBhurundi neYuganda iwona mazwe anomthwalo omncane.
Hausa: A halin yanzu, Namibiya da Angola da Sudan ta Kudu da Burundi da kuma Uganda suna da mafi ƙarancin nauyin cutar.
Northern Sotho: Mo lebakeng le, Namibia, Angola, South Sudan, Burundi le Uganda di na le bothata bja fase ka ga bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በናሚቢያ፣ አንጎላ፣ ደቡብ ሱዳን፣ ቡሩንዲ እና ኡጋንዳ ጫናው ቀንሶ ታይቷል፡፡

English: The findings could be useful in implementing epidemiological intervention and allocation of scarce resources based on heterogeneity of the disease patterns.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu bisobola okuyamba mu kukola ku bwetaavu bw’obujjanjabi n’okugabanya ebikozesebwa mu bujjanjabi eby’ebbula okusinziira ku bifo obulwadde gye businga.
Yoruba: Àwọn àwárí náà lè wúlò ní ṣíṣe ìdásí lọ́rí ìlànà fifálẹ̀mọ́ àjàkálẹ̀-àrùn àti ìpínká ohun èlò tó mẹ́he ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú ìṣonírúurú bátánì àrùn náà.
Zulu: Okutholiwe kungasiza ekungeneleleni kokusebenza ngemibulalazwe nokwabiwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezingandile kususelwa ekuhlukahlukaneni kwamaphethini ezifo.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken zai iya zama da amfani wajen aiwatar da agaji na annobar da rarraba kayayyaki masu ƙaranci dangane da bambancin yanayin cutar.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tše di ka ba mohola ge re phethagatša tsenogare mabapi le malwetši le kabo ya methopo ye e sa hwetšagalego gabonolo go eya ka go fetogafetoga ga sebopego sa bolwetši.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ በሽታው በተለያየ ሁኔታ የሚከሰትበትን ንድፍ ተገን በማድረግ አገር አቀፋዊ የወረርሽኝ ምላሾችን ለመተግበር እና እጥረት ላይ ያሉ ግብአቶች በበቂ ሁኔታ ለመመደብ ሊጠቅሙ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: Researchers used statistical models to calculate where in Africa COVID-19 infections were the most prevalent, and how quickly the virus spread in different parts of the continent.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakozesa ennyinyonnyolero ez’ebibalo okubala wa mu Afrika obulwadde bwa COVID-19 gye bwasinga okukwata abantu, n’emisinde akawuka kwe kaatambulira mu bitundu bya ssemazinga ono eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí lo módẹ́ẹ̀li ìṣirò láti ṣírò ibi tí ìkóràn COVID-19 ti gbinlẹ̀ jùlọ ní Áfíríkà, àti bí àrùn náà ṣe ń tàn kálẹ̀ lóríṣiríṣi ibi ní kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basebenzise izindlelakusebenza zocwaningo lwezibalo ukubala ukuthi ukubhebhetheka keep-COVID-19 kudlange kuphi kakhulu ne-Afrika, nokuthi lesi sifo sibhebhetheke masinya kangakanani ezindaweni ezihlukene zezwekazi.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun yi amfani da samfurorin ƙididdiga don ƙididdige inda cutar COVID-19 ta fi yawa a Afirka, da kuma yadda ƙwayar cutar ke yaɗuwa cikin sauri a sassa daban-daban na nahiyar (Afrika).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše mekgwa ya dipalopalo go hlakanya gore ke kae mo Afrika fao diphetetšo tša COVID-19 di bego di le tše ntši kudu, le gore baerase ye e phatlaletše ka pela bjang ka dikarolong tšeo di phatlaletšego tša ka khonthinenteng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የስታትስቲክስ ሞዴሎችን በመጠቀም በኮቪድ-19 በሽታ በሰፊው የተጠቁ ቦታዎችን እና ቫይረሱ በተለያዩ የአህጉሩ ሃገራት ላይ እንዴት በፍጥነት እንደተስፋፋ ለማስላት ችለዋል፡፡

English: They found that West and North Africa were the most affected overall, while the disease spread the quickest in North Africa and made its way through central and southern Africa.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti ebitundu by’Obugwanjuba n’Obukiikakkono bwa Afrika bye byasinga okukosebwa okutwaliza awamu, so ng’obulwadde buno bwasinga okwanguwa okusaasaana mu bitundu by’Obukiikakkono bwa Afrika era ne buwaguza okugenda mu masekkati n’obukiikaddyo bwa Afrika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé Ìwọ̀-Oòrùn àti Àríwá Áfíríkà ni ó palára jùlọ, nígbà tí àrùn náà yára tànkálẹ̀ jùlọ ní Àríwá Áfíríkà àti bó ti lọ káàkiri àárín àti gúùsù Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi iNtshonalanga neNyakatho ye-Afrika khahlamekzeka kakhulu kunezinye izindawo, yize leli gciwane labhebhetheka ukudlula ezinye izindawo eNyakatho ne-Afrika laqhubekela enkabeni naseNingizimu ne-Afrika.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa Yammacin Afirka da Arewacin Afirka ne suka fi fama da cutar gabaɗaya, yayin da cutar ta fi saurain yaɗuwa a Arewacin Afirka kuma ta ratsa tsakiyar Afirka da kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore Bodikela le Leboa la Afrika ke tšona tšeo di amegilego kudu ka kakaretšo, mola e le gore bolwetši bjona bo phatlalala ka lebelo kudu ka Leboa la Afrika gomme bja tsena ka bogare le borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: በጥቅሉ፣ በሰፊው የተጠቁት ቦታዎች ሰሜን እና ምእራብ አፍሪካ እንደሆኑ ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ በሽታው በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት በሰሜን አፍሪካ በመስፋፋት ወደ መሃከለኛው እና ደቡብ አፍሪካም አቅንቷል፡፡

English: They found that travel restrictions play an important role in slowing the spread of COVID-19 and in making the most of scarce healthcare resources.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti okukugira entambula kikola kya maanyi mu kukendeeza ku kusaasaana kwa COVID-19 era n’okukozesa obulungi ebyobujjanjabi ebitono.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé ìgbégilé ìrìn-àjò kópa tó ṣe pàtàkì ní ṣíṣèdínwọ́ ìtànká COVID-19 àti ní ṣíṣèmúlò ohun èlo èto ìlera tí ò pọ̀ lọ́nà tó dára jùlọ.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ukuncishiswa kokuhamba kwabantu kudlala indima enkulu ekwehliseni ukubhehetheka kwe-COVID-19 kanye nokwelula ukusebenza kwezinsizakusebenza zezempilo ezentulekayo.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa takunkumin taƙaita tafiye-tafiye yana taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen rage yaɗuwar cutar COVID-19 da kuma samar da mafi karancin kyayyakin kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore mellwane ya mabapi le maeto e raloka tema ye bohlokwa go fokotša go phatlalala ga COVID-19 le go šomiša methopo ya tlhokomelo ya maphelo yeo e sa hwetšagalego gabonolo kudu.
Amharic: የህዝብ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ የሚደረጉ ገደቦች የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ የሚስፋፋበትን ፍጥነት እንደሚቀንሱት ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ በእጥረት ላይ ያሉ የጤና መጠበቂያ ግብአቶችንም በብቁ ሁኔታ ለመጠቀም ይረዳሉ፡፡

English: The novel coronavirus (COVID-19) disease, caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) emerged in the city of Wuhan, China in December 2019, and it arrived relatively late in Africa but it quickly spread to every country on the continent.
Luganda: Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka corona akapya (COVID-19), obuleetebwa akawuka ka corona ak’amaanyi akakwata omussizo (SARS-Cov-2) bwatandikira mu kibuga ky’e Wuhan, mu China mu Deesemba wa 2019, era nga bwatuuka luvannyumako mu Afrika naye nga bwasaasaana mangu mu mawanga gonna ku ssemazinga ono.
Yoruba: Àrun tuntun kòrónà (COVID-19) yìí, tí àìsàn àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn kòrónà ajẹ́mọ-èémí (SARS-CoV-2) ṣokùnfà jẹ jáde láti ìlú Wuhan, China ní oṣù Ọpẹ́ 2019, ó sì pé kó tó tàn dé ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ṣùgbọ́n ó yára láti tàn káàkiri gbogbo orílẹ̀-ède kọ́ńtínẹ́ẹ̀tì náà.
Zulu: Isifo esisha sokhuvethe (COVID-19), esidalwa igciwane elicindezela ukuphefumula (SARS-CoV-2) saqubuka edolobheni lase Wuhan, eShayina ngoDisemba/Zibandlela ka-2019, lase lifika sekudlule isikhashana e-Afrika kodwa labhebhethekela kuwo wonke amazwe kulelizwekazi.
Hausa: Sabuwar cutar coronavirus (COVID-19), wacce mummunar cutar numfashi ta (SARS-CoV-2) ta haifar ta ɓulla a birnin Wuhan na ƙasar Sin a watan Disamba na shekarar 2019, kuma ta isa a Afirka a makare amma cikin sauri ta yaɗu zuwa kowace ƙasa a nahiyar.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja coronavirus (COVID-19), bjo bo bakwago ke coronavirus ya go šitiša go hema (SARS-CoV-2) bo thomile go tšwelela ka toropokgolong ya Wuhan, ka China ka Desemere 2019, gomme bo fihlile moragonyana ka Afrika eupša bja phatlalala ka lebelo ka nageng ye nngwe le ye nngwe ka mo khonthinenteng.
Amharic: አዲሱ ኮሮና ቫይረስ፣ ወይም ኮቪድ-19 የተሰኘው በሽታ፣ ሳርስ- ኮቭ -2 (ከባድ እና አጣዳፊ የመተንፈሻ አካላት በሽታ) በተሰኘ ቫይረስ የሚከሰት ሲሆን፣ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የታየው ቻይና ውስጥ በምትገኝ፣ ውሃን በተሰኘች ከተማ በታህሳስ 2012 ዓ.ም

English: The researchers set out to get a clearer picture of how availability of doctors and other healthcare facilities affected where and how quickly COVID-19 infections occurred.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagenderera okufuna ekifaananyi ekituufu eky’engeri okubeerawo kw’abasawo n’ebikozesebwa ebirala mu bujjanjabi gye bisalawo ebifo n’emisinde COVID-19 gye yasaasaanirako.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà jáde láti ní ìmọ̀ tó yarantí lórí i bí iye àwọn dókítà àti àwọn ohun èlò iṣẹ́ ìlera mìíràn ṣe ń kópa lórí i ibi àti bí àrùn COVID-19 ṣe ń jẹ jáde ní kíákíá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphume umkhankanso wokutholisisa ukuthi ukuba khona kodokotela nezinye izingqalasizinda ezisebenza ngezempilo kuba namthelela muni ekutheni i-COVID-19 isabalala kuphi futhi ngesivinini esingakanani.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ƙuduri niyyar samun cikakken bayani na yadda wadatar likitoci da sauran wuraren kiwon lafiya ya shafi inda da kuma saurin yadda kamuwa da cutar COVID-19 ya faru.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba hlama sebopego seo se kwešišegago mabapi le gore go hwetšagala ga dingaka le mafelo a mangwe a tlhokomelo ya maphelo di amile gore diphetetšo tša COVID-19 di hlagile kae le gona bjang.
Amharic: ላይ ነው፡፡ ከሌሎች ሃገሮች አንጻር፣ ወደ አፍሪካ የገባው ዘግይቶ ቢሆንም፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ወደ ሁሉም የአህጉሩ ሃገራት ለመዛመት ችሏል፡፡

English: The results can help governments allocate the scarce healthcare resources where they are needed most.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu bisobola okuyamba zi-gavumenti okuteeka ebikozesebwa mu bujjanjabi eby’ebbula mu bifo gye bisinga okwetaagibwa.
Yoruba: Àbájáde náà lè ran ìjọba lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe ìpín ohun èlò ìlera tí kò tó sí àwọn ibi tọ́ ti nílò wọn jùlọ.
Zulu: Imiphumela ingasiza ohulumeni ukuthi bakwazi ukuyisa izinsizakusebenza ezingandile lapho ezidingeka khona kakhulu.
Hausa: Sakamakon zai iya taimaka wa gwamnatoci su ware kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu ƙaranci a inda ake buƙatar su.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di ka thuša mebušo go aba methopo ya tlhokomelo ya maphelo ye e sa hwetšagalego gabonolo fao di hlokegago kudu.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የዶክተሮች እና የሌሎች የጤና መጠበቂያ ተቋማት መኖር/ አለመኖር፣ የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ የት እና በምን ያህል ፍጥነት እንዲከሰት ተጽዕኖ እንዳደረጉ በግልጽ ለማወቅ ሞክረዋል፡፡

English: To understand how this happened, researchers have used the Poisson model of statistics to calculate when and where each of the COVID-19 infections happened in Africa over 62 days, from 14th February 2020 to 15th April 2020.
Luganda: Okutegeera engeri kino gye kyakolebwa, abanoonyereza baakozesa enkola ya Poisson ey’ebibalo okubala ddi na wa buli muntu eyakwatibwa COVID-19 gye yali mu Afrika okumala ennaku 62, okuva nga 14 Ogwokubiri 2020 okutuuka nga 15 Ogwokuna 2020.
Yoruba: Láti ní òye bí èyí ṣe ṣẹlẹ̀, àwọn aṣèwádìí ti lo módẹ́ẹ̀lì ìṣirò Poisson láti ṣírò ìgbà àti ibi tí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan ìkóràn COVID-19 ti ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Áfíríkà ju ọjọ́ 62 lọ, láti 14th Èrèlé 2020 sí 15th Igbe 2020.
Zulu: Ukuqondsisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke kanjani, abacwaningi basebenzise imininingwanezibalo zendendlelakusebenza yePoisson ukubala ukuthi ukutheleleka nge-COVID-19 kwenzeke nini nokuthi kwenzeke kuphi e-Afrika ezinsukwini ezingama-62, kusukela kumhla ka-14 Febhuwari 2020 kuya kumhla ka-15 Ephreli 2020.
Hausa: Don fahimtar yadda hakan ta faru, masu binciken sun yi amfani da tsarin ƙididdiga na samfurin Poisson don ƙididdige lokacin da kuma inda kowane nau’in cututtukan COVID-19 ya faru a Afirka sama da kwanaki 62, daga ranar 14 ga Fabrairu na shekarar 2020 zuwa 15 ga watan Afrilu na shejarar 2020.
Northern Sotho: Go kwešiša gore se se diregilego bjang, banyakišiši ba šomišitše mokgwa wa dipalopalo wa Poisson go tseba gore diphetetšo tša COVID-19 di diregile neng le gona kae ka Afrika mo matšatšing a 62, go thoma ka la 14 Feperware 2020 go fihla ka la 15 Aprele 2020.
Amharic: በምርምር የተገኙት ውጤቶች መንግስታት በእጥረት ላይ ያሉ የጤና መጠበቂያ ግብአቶችን በጣም በሚፈለጉባቸው ቦታዎች ላይ እንዲያዳርሱ ይረዷቸዋል፡፡ ይህ እንዴት እንደተከሰተ ለመረዳት በ62 ቀናት በአፍሪካ ውስጥ የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ የት እና መች እንደተከሰተ ተመራማሪዎች ፖይስን የተባለ የስታትስቲክስ ሞዴል በመጠቀም ያጠኑ ሲሆን፣ ከየካቲት 6 - ሚያዚያ 7፡ 2012 ዓ.ም.

English: They used public data reported by the World Health Organization, for 47 countries.
Luganda: Baakozesa obubaka obw’olukale obwafulumizibwa World Health Organization, obw’amawanga 47.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo data tí Ilé Iṣẹ́ Ìlera Agbáyé fi síta, fún orílẹ̀-ède 47.
Zulu: Basebenzise imininingo yomphakathi abayithole enhlanganweni yezempilo yomhlaba, i-World Health Organisation, emazweni angama-47.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da bayanan jama'a da Ƙungiyar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ruwaito na ƙasashe 47.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše tshedimošo ye ba e hwetšago setšhabeng yeo e beilwego ke Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase, dinageng tše 47.
Amharic: በአለም አቀፍ የጤና ድርጅት ለ 47 ሃገራት የተሰጠውን የህዝብ መረጃ ሪፖርትም ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: The results showed that Senegal, Egypt, and Mauritania were the first to be hit hard by high infection rates in the four weeks.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu byalaga nti Senegal, Egypt, ne Mauritania ze zaasooka okulumbibwa ennyo n’omuwendo gw’abantu abangi ennyo abakwatibwa mu wiiki ezo ennya.
Yoruba: Àbájáde èsì náà fi hàn pé Senegal, Egypt, àti Mauritania ni ó kọ́kọ́ ní ìpalára látara ìkóràn láàárín ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́rin.
Zulu: Imiphumela ikhombise ukuthi i-Senegal, iGibhithe, neMorithaniya aba awokuqala ukushawa kakhulu amazinga aphezulu okutheleleka kula maviki amane.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa ƙasashen Senegal da Masar, da kuma Mauritania ne suka fara fuskantar kamuwa da cutar a cikin makonni huɗu.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laeditše gore Senegal, Egypt, le Mauritania di bile dinaga tša mathomo tša go itemogela seabe se segolo sa diphetetšo mo dibekeng tše nne.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት በ4 ሳምንታት ውስጥ ሴኔጋል፤ግብጽ እና ሞሪታኒያ በበሽታው ሀይለኛ ጥቃት ለመመታት የመጀመሪያዎቹ እንደነበሩ ነው፡፡

English: They found that Djibouti, Tunisia, Morocco, and Algeria, were the countries where the most infections per 100 000 people occurred over the 62 days.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti Djibouti, Tunisia, Morocco, ne Algeria, ge mawanga agaalimu abantu abangi abaakwatibwa ku buli bantu 100 000 mu nnaku 62.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé Djibouti, Tunisia, Morocco, àti Algeria, ni àwọn orílẹ̀-ède tí ìkóràn náà ti pọ̀jù pẹ̀lú 100 000 ènìyàn tó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní bíi ọjọ́ 62.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi iJibhuthi, iThuniziya, iMorokho, neAljeriya kwaba ayengamazwe la kwatheleleka abantu abaningi kwabangu-100 000 ezinsukwini ezingama-62.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa Djibouti da Tunisiya da Moroko da kuma Aljeriya, su ne ƙasashen da suka fi kamuwa da cutar mutum ɗaya a cikin mutane 100,000 cikin kwanaki 62.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore Djibouti, Tunisia, Morocco, le Algeria, di bile dinaga tšeo di amegilego kudu ka diphetetšo go batho ba 100 000 tšeo di hlagilego mo matšatšing a 62.
Amharic: በ62 ቀን ልዩነት ውስጥ በየአንዳንዱ 100000 ሰው ከፍተኛ ኢንፌክሽን የተከሰተባቸው ሃገሮች ጅቡቲ፣ ቱኒዚያ፣ ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ እንደሆኑ አግኝተዋል፡፡

English: The statistical methods of the research meant that the researchers have to separate the study period into six equal week periods.
Luganda: Enkola z’okunoonyereza zino ez’ebibalo zaategeeza nti abanoonyereza balina okugabanya ekiseera ky’okunoonyereza mu biseera ebyenkanankana mukaaga.
Yoruba: Ìlàna ìṣirò náà túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn aṣèwádìí ní láti ṣe ìyapa àwọn àsìkò ìwádìí sí ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́fà ọgbọọgba.
Zulu: Lezi zindlelakwenza zokubala zocwaningo asho ukuthi abacwaningi kumele bahlukanise ibanga lesikhathi libe izikhawu eziyisithupha ezilinganayo.
Hausa: Hanyoyin ƙididdiga na binciken na nufin cewa masu binciken dole ne su raba lokacin binciken zuwa cikin lokutan mako guda shida daidai.
